name: Recruiting and school dashboard
tagline: One ranked to-do list for every contact, application, deadline and follow-up.
summary: My master dashboard. Agents watch email, Slack, LinkedIn and WhatsApp for new connections, job openings and things I owe people, and every night they also check my school portals for deadlines and holds. Everything lands in one ranked list, with follow-up drafts ready for me to review.
problem: MBA recruiting and school admin are spread across inboxes, group chats and half a dozen portals, and follow-ups and deadlines slip through the cracks.
how: Integrations read new messages and posts from Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
A job scraper agent pulls openings worth pursuing.
A follow-up agent spots action items and drafts replies (drafts only, never sent).
A research agent finds articles to mention when reconnecting with a contact.
Each night, saved browser sessions check Canvas, 12Twenty, CAESAR and other school portals for holds and deadlines in the next four weeks.
A priority engine ranks it all into one list, shown in a dashboard and a menu-bar popup.
highlights: Personal data is redacted everywhere it's shown or logged
